title: Zesty Dense Egyptian Chicken Flatbread
description: A citrusy and dense Egyptian dish featuring naan bread, perfect for a quick fix, this recipe is low-glycemic-friendly and delicious. It combines the flavors of chicken, lemon, and spices on a crispy flatbread.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and mix until the chicken is well coated with the marinade.
Knead the chicken mixture for about 5 minutes until it becomes dense.
Place the naan bread on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
Divide the chicken mixture into 4 equal parts and place each part on a toasted naan bread.
Sprinkle chopped parsley on top of the chicken.
Bake the flatbreads in the oven for 15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the flatbreads from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
